stories.goal: to submit a purchase request through an online form
stories.benefit: requests are complete and not lost in email

stories.goal: each request routed to the right approvers based on its amount
stories.benefit: the approval rules are applied consistently

stories.goal: to see the status of my request at any time
stories.benefit: I know where it is in the approval process

stories.goal: to receive a reminder when a request is waiting for me
to reject a request with a reason
stories.benefit: the requester knows what to change

stories.goal: an audit trail of all approval actions
stories.benefit: I can see who approved what and when

stories.goal: approved requests exported to the ERP system
stories.benefit: orders do not have to be entered twice
urgent purchases are not held up

criteria.when: I submit a request without a budget code
criteria.then: it is not submitted and the missing budget code is shown
it is not submitted and I am asked to attach at least one quote

criteria.given: all required fields and a quote are provided
criteria.then: the request is saved with a reference number
only the department head is asked to approve
the department head and finance are asked to approve
the department head, finance and the managing director are asked to approve
I see its current status and which approver it is waiting for

criteria.given: a request has waited for my approval for 3 working days

criteria.when: I do not enter a reason

criteria.given: I reject a request with a reason
criteria.then: the requester is notified with the reason
the user, the action, the date and the time are recorded and cannot be changed
the request appears in the ERP system
